clips.title: The story
paras: Coleman Farthing, once a mill worker, seeks vengeance from Brill against the Agamand family. During the Third War, he stayed to defend their estate with his fellow workers, and they died beside their stubborn masters. The Agamands rose again as mindless thralls of the Lich King.

Before the Third War, the Agamands were Tirisfal Glades' wealthiest and most influential farming family. Their mills and fertile pastures yielded grain through the labor of dozens of tenant farmers and millers. When the Plague of Undeath crossed Lordaeron, the family refused to flee or abandon its ancestral lands. They believed their stone walls and loyal workers could hold back the horrors advancing from the east.

Coleman Farthing and the other workers trusted their lords' assurances and stayed to defend the estate. The Scourge overwhelmed them. The Agamands and their workers were slaughtered, then raised into undeath where they fell. Farthing eventually broke free through Sylvanas Windrunner's liberation. The Agamand patriarchs and heirs remained under the Lich King's mental grip, wandering the ruined mills as mindless Scourge sentries.

Coleman Farthing now lives in Brill, still bitter toward the masters whose pride cost him his mortal life. Seeking vengeance and closure, he sends Forsaken champions to Agamand Mills to destroy Gregor, Nissa, and Thurman Agamand. He hopes his former masters kept enough awareness behind their rotting faces to feel terror as their unlife came to an end.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Agamand family was the most prosperous family in Tirisfal Glades. I used to work their mills...before the Plague.
When the Scourge first came, the Agamands fortified their home and convinced those in their employ to remain and help them defend. We were fools, but at least we were loyal fools.
The Agamands, in their pride, doomed us to undeath. And now they are minions of the Scourge!
Serve the Forsaken by defeating the Agamands who fell to the Plague. Serve me by bringing me their remains.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the remains of the Agamands? Are those cursed beasts finally destroyed?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Revenge has a sweet taste, don't you think? When you destroyed the Agamands, did you catch any hint of free will within them? I hope so. I hope they knew fear before they were smashed into oblivion.
It is a foolish hope, I know. But it is a hope I foster nonetheless.
